input.quote:
18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.</quote>
<parameter name="rationale">Section 18 is the only insurance provision in the agreement and it meets every preferred element: CGL of USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate; professional E&O of USD 2,000,000; cyber and privacy liability of USD 5,000,000 (granted unconditionally, so the Customer Data condition is satisfied for this hosting vendor); workers' compensation as required by law; and certificates of insurance on request under 18.2. No carve-out or limitation elsewhere in the document reduces these lines. Additional terms (employer's liability, primary coverage, notice of cancellation, non-limitation of liability) are favourable to us and are not flagged. No redline required.
